name: Sigil of Thoradin
summary: Tor'gan has restored the Sigil of Thoradin, and Zengu waits in Hammerfall for its return. The sigil can open the seal on Trollbane's tomb.

sections.title: The Restored Sigil
sections.body: Tor'gan's reconstruction has worked. The Sigil of Thoradin can open the seal on Trollbane's tomb, so he sends you back to Zengu in Hammerfall. Zengu has more for you to do.

sections.title: Halfway There
sections.body: Zengu asks whether you have the second sigil. With it, he says, you are halfway to taking Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb. The third sigil remains hard to find because its keepers move about Arathi. Zengu trusts you will find it.

faq.q: What is the Sigil of Thoradin used for?
aliases: what does sigil of thoradin do
why do we need the sigil
faq.answer: The restored sigil can open the seal on Trollbane's tomb.

faq.q: Who do you bring the Sigil of Thoradin to?
aliases: where do i take the sigil
who turns in sigil of thoradin
faq.answer: Bring the restored sigil to Zengu in Hammerfall. Tor'gan sends you back to him.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the search for Trol'kalar?
aliases: how far along is this quest
faq.answer: This step follows The Broken Sigil, when Tor'gan reconstructed the sigil from the pieces you brought him.
